SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE: At GlobalQualityWeight 0.1, ResolveSimulationInterval maps the CPU Burst visor solver to 5 Hz. At GlobalQualityWeight 1.0 it maps to 60 Hz. The transition uses a smooth polynomial and math.lerp, with event paths forcing a single immediate schedule for breath, splash, wipe, pressure, and glitch. Below approximately 0.3, CPU updates are sparse and the shader resolves LowTierWeight01/dynamicVisorWeight/refractionWeight, skips ComputeDropletMask value-noise work, avoids Snell refraction sampling, and renders a static edge-weighted film plus chroma fallback. Middle quality blends cadence and masks. High and ultra restore 60 Hz scalar updates, head-motion UV skew, richer refraction, reflection tint, salt crystals, and suspended silt presentation.

POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.COMPLETION_POLICY: Tick never completes the job. It returns while scheduled work is active. LateFrameTick is the nonblocking visual-sync commit point and OnDisable is the only forced completion site because shutdown must reclaim graphics/native ownership.
POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.MUTATION_BARRIER: External mock, pressure, silt, surface, wipe, and editor writes stage primitive pending fields while _hasScheduledWork is true. Pending values are copied into Vault buffers only before the next schedule, after the previous job has committed.
